extracted.intended_audience: writers submitting speculative fiction novelettes to Strange Horizons
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for submitting speculative fiction novelettes to Strange Horizons, specifying eligible length, opening date, a submission cap, and exclusivity across multiple open submission windows. Points authors to the fuller fiction submission guidelines for procedural details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible length (novelette)
rubrics_metrics.description: Speculative fiction novelette submissions between the word count of 10,000 and 18,000 words.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission open date
rubrics_metrics.description: On June 4th, we will be opening for speculative fiction novelette submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission cap (300)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once we reach the cap, we’ll close our portal while we work through the submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Portal open/closed policy
rubrics_metrics.description: If our portal is open, we are still accepting stories, but once it is closed, please do not send us your work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple/simultaneous submission restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: We will not be allowing multiple or simultaneous submissions to our other open windows throughout the year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General Submissions: April 16th; Indigenous Author Submissions: November 3rd. That means writers may only send one story across all three open submissions. If you have submitted a story to our April general open call, you may not submit for the other two open calls in June and November.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encouragement to submit promptly
rubrics_metrics.description: Since we are using a submission cap, we encourage authors to submit promptly!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because the portal will close once the cap is reached, early submission increases the chance your story is considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference to full fiction submission guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Please see our fiction submission guidelines for more details on how to submit once we open and what we publish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The linked fiction submission guidelines contain fuller procedural and publication-detail requirements not repeated on this page.
